links.outcome: Safety constraint violations by LLM agents in high-risk primary-care cases
links.effect: Even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases; performance degrades as action space scales.
links.quote: Crucially, we uncover a clinical quality-safety gap: even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases.

unlisted_practices: Constrained reinforcement learning (C-GRPO) to train agents with explicit safety constraints; improves over unconstrained RL but remains far from clinically acceptable safety
Imposing a topological workflow prior over the agent's clinical action space

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an agentic benchmark (GPAgentBench-2K) to test LLM agents across clinical actions, safety-informed abstention, and constrained RL optimization without testing a real-world organizational deployment practice.
